method: register rear elbow/forearm height against actual current front and side; remove low hanging assembly
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 edit target REAR, Image 2 same machine's current FRONT, Image 3 current LEFT SIDE. They must depict SAME RIGHT ELBOW BEND/forearm HEIGHT. Preserve ENTIRE image1 EXCEPT the anatomical RIGHT lower arm on viewer RIGHT.
MAIN ERROR: Image1 right forearm is still hanging DOWN by hip, round rear cap at lower thigh height. But Image2/3 right elbow is BENT FORWARD, drill held FORWARD near lower CHEST / upper WAIST. This pose is wrong on rear. Correct the WHOLE lower arm, not just hiding the point.
Keep right shoulder and ivory UPPER ARM ending at existing elbow. Remove ALL of the old down-hanging navy/gold gauntlet below that elbow, including its current large black/gold round cap at mid-thigh level. Restore the white background/visible side of fuel tank and hip behind it.
Reconstruct right elbow BENT FORWARD with forearm projecting AWAY from rear camera, level with LOWER CHEST / UPPER WAIST as in side image3. The rear observer sees the ELBOW BACK armor at this bend, while most forearm and drill extend in FRONT of the body, hidden behind elbow/upper-arm silhouette. So show a compact dark navy elbow-back armor piece with gold side hinge and a foreshortened glimpse of navy/gold forearm around it; do NOT hang another long sleeve down. If any round drive housing is visible, it is small, up at ELBOW height near the side wing-root engine cluster, not at thigh level.
The complete RIGHT forearm/drill rear projection should terminate around the robot's WAIST BELT height, above the top ends of leg launcher pods. No big drill base extends down alongside outer thigh. No gold cone/point or triangle visible in rear. Right drill points forward AWAY into depth, not downward/outward in image plane. This is the SAME pose as image2/3 where elbow bends forward and holds drill almost horizontally. Never add a right fist, a second arm, or move the shoulder.
Backpack with central rear gold-rimmed black/red jet and exactly TWO ivory tanks stays exactly image1. Do not alter head, body, long legs, stance, left shield interior, existing cannons/wings, small wing-root engine count, lower booster nacelles, heel navy panels or any colors. Preserve image1 camera and framing, white background, no guides/text. ONLY right lower arm registration/occlusion changes.
